fix(desktop): wire playback/score settings into the workspace (#95)

Four more dead settings from the same review pass as the 採譜 wiring:
- skipSeconds now drives the ←/→ jump commands (was hardcoded 5s).
- playbackRate applies to the transport on change (standard rate).
- followPlayback seeds the score follow toggle.
- scoreInitialView seeds the score view mode per document.
Props thread App -> ScoreWorkspace -> ScoreReadyWorkspace as
initialViewMode/followPlayback (mount-time seeds; the document key
remounts per revision).
